precepts.text: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first. That is what the white man knows: it is not Judah over in Africa, it is not Judah in Saudi Arabia; it is Judah here, and the Lord is going to raise them up first.
precepts.point: Back to the hearings: "Within the Negro population of the United States the Negro working class is destined to be the vanguard of all liberation movements, and may become the vanguard of the liberation movement of the Negro peasant masses on an international scale. A strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all those backward parts of the world where the Negroes are oppressed by the various imperialist powers." You see what they called all the other places: backward parts of the earth. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. People ask why Canada and Europe have free healthcare and not America: they do not want the American blacks to get it, because this group here is more dangerous than all the other groups. Sisters, do not just let your boys run out; the white man has his eyes on your sons; they know what stock they come from.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar told Ashpenaz to bring “certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes; Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science”. That is what Deacon Malachi was talking about: Babylon didn't take any old body. Esau did the same thing. They said no, we need the best ones, and put them in North America. The ones they left behind were not the same, and that is why you see Africa the way it is.

The hearings they read say it: within the Negro population of the United States, the Negro working class is destined to be the vanguard of all liberation movements, and a strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all those backward parts of the world. See what they called all the other places: backward parts of the earth. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. Canada and Europe have free healthcare and America does not, because they don't want the American blacks to get it; this group here is more dangerous than all the other groups.

That is why the Lord said: “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. That is what the white man knows. It isn't Judah over in Africa; it isn't Judah in Saudi Arabia. It's Judah here, and the Lord is going to raise them up first.

So be proud of this history. Don't be mad; be glad. Sisters, don't just let your boys run out: the white man has his eyes on your sons, because they know what stock they come from. Even if the father was no good, the son is still of good stock, and there is still hope for him.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
The hearings said the American Negro is the one who is going to lead all the others, the vanguard of the liberation movement on an international scale. The Bible said it first: “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”.

Judah is going to be the one teaching and preaching, and he is the one who is going to know where the tribes are. “let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

That is why, as in Daniel, the captor chose the best of the children of Israel, the king's seed and the princes, and brought them into the land. Esau took the best stock and put them in North America, and the American Economic Association wrote that the Negro stock landed in America was physically superior to the average of that left behind, the soundest and strongest, who transmitted to their offspring their qualities. We didn't write that; the white man wrote that. Judah in America is the one the Lord brings unto his people and helps from his enemies.

precepts.text: My son, keep the flower of thine age sound, and give not thy strength to strangers: do not give your strength to other nations, or wicked women. When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed: sow with thine own race; trusting in the goodness of thy stock. So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent. You did not know the word race was in the Bible in terms of your nationality. This is what your sons and daughters have to know, instead of running around giving their seed to any old thing out there in the world.
precepts.point: Reading shown from the American Economic Association: "In view of these facts, it is probable that the Negro stock landed in America was physically superior to the average of that left behind. No doubt many were permanently broken in health, but it could not have been so with any large proportion, or the trade could not have flourished as it did. It is probable that the great majority, being by nature the soundest and strongest, quickly recovered and transmitted to their offspring their congenital qualities." We did not write that; the white man wrote that. The books we read, white folks wrote this stuff. Sisters, you may have had a no good man, but your son is of that good stock; you better thank God.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
Babylon chose children of Israel “in whom was no blemish”, and the white man's own books say the stock landed in America was the soundest and strongest. A lot of our women don't understand this. “My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” Don't give your strength to other nations, or to wicked women.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed”: sow with thine own race. “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” That's some good stock right there, and some of you are ashamed of it.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” You didn't know the word race was in the Bible, in terms of ethnicity, in terms of your nationality. This is what your sons and daughters have to know, instead of running around giving their seed to any old thing out there in the world.

And don't hold your breath for reparations. Esau is not stupid. After slavery we had no reparations and still built great, advanced societies without white folks, and they came up with a reason to drop dynamite on us and destroy them, even Seneca Village in Central Park. Trust in the goodness of your stock: we can build without them.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar chose children “of the king's seed, and of the princes”, royalty, “skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science.” Among them were “Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah”, all four of them eunuchs and all of royal seed. Verse 17 shows where their wisdom came from: “As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.” The Lord gave it to him.

“And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.” The king spoke with them, and they were the smartest of all his eunuchs, so he kept them by him. “And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm”: ten times better than all his witches, warlocks and wizards.

It is no coincidence. Babylon used our forefathers Daniel and them to advance itself in ancient times, and modern Babylon used a black man, Benjamin Banneker, to help lay out its capital. Banneker was like Daniel: of tribal royalty, as his father asserted, skillful in wisdom, understanding science, building clocks and making almanacs. He may not have known what they were doing with the capital, but he was used for it anyway, and he was wiser than all their sorcerers and those masons of his day.

precepts.point: It is no coincidence that Babylon used Daniel to advance itself and modern Babylon used a black man to lay out its capital; the slave masters knew that though captive we were not stupid, and Egypt, Persia, Greece, Rome and America all used the genius of the conquered.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
Years later, Belshazzar needed a vision explained, and he was told: “There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him.” Daniel had the wisdom of the gods.

Nebuchadnezzar “made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers” this man. The Chaldeans were the elite brain of Babylon, the wisest men in the kingdom, and Daniel was set over them, and over the witches and sorcerers too. Read on: “an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel.” He was a dissolver of doubts: any doubt you had, he could dissolve it.

“now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.” Go get Daniel; if anyone knows, it's Daniel. By then he was older, and the captive of Judah was still the wisest man in Babylon. That is the superiority of the chosen people, and the reason the nations have always used the genius of Israel.

precepts.text: Keep therefore and do them, for this is your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall say, surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people; our reputation for wisdom came from keeping the law.
precepts.point: It is no coincidence that Babylon used Daniel to advance itself and modern Babylon used a black man to lay out its capital; the slave masters knew that though captive we were not stupid, and Egypt, Persia, Greece, Rome and America all used the genius of the conquered.

note.label: The Superiority of the Chosen People

precepts.why:
Where does that wisdom come from? “Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.” The commandments were our wisdom and understanding to do.

Read on: “For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for? And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?” When we applied our commandments and our laws, the nations looked at us and said, look how wise and understanding these people are. We became very famous and had a strong reputation of being a wise people.

So whenever we got conquered and enslaved, the slave masters knew: even though we have them as captives, they ain't stupid, they're very smart, so we have to use them as best we can while we have them. It happened in Egypt, in Babylon, in Persia, with the Greeks and Romans, and with the white man in America and Africa, using the genius of the slaves and the colonized. That is why Babylon took Daniel and his fellows, the king's seed, to stand in the palace.

precepts.text: Children of Israel skilful in all wisdom and understanding science stood in the king's palace; the same spirit that was in Joseph.
precepts.point: The children of Israel brought to Babylon were skilful in all wisdom, cunning in knowledge, understanding science, and able to stand in the king's palace to give counsel; and they were taught the tongue of the Chaldeans, for we have the capability to understand multiple languages as well.

note.label: Genesis 41: Pharaoh's Dreams and Joseph's Rise Over Egypt

precepts.why:
The king of Babylon sent for “certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes; Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.”

That is the same spirit that was in Joseph. Pharaoh asked, “Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?” and told Joseph there was none so discreet and wise as he. Israel has always been a wise and understanding people: Joseph in Egypt, Daniel in ancient Babylon, and up until this day, a people responsible for many inventions and cunning arts.

The children of Israel in Babylon were skilful in all wisdom, understanding science, and able to stand in the king’s palace to give counsel, just as Joseph stood before Pharaoh. And they were taught the tongue of the Chaldeans, for we have the capability to understand multiple languages as well.

precepts.text: Isaiah's word is fulfilled when the children of Judah, including Daniel, are made eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
precepts.point: Hezekiah answers that the word of the Most High is good, content that peace and truth be in his days. This same account is given in Isaiah 39.

note.label: 2 Kings 20: Hezekiah's Healing and His Folly

precepts.why:
The king of Babylon told Ashpenaz “the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes”, children without blemish, skilful in wisdom, able “to stand in the king’s palace”, to be taught “the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.” “Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.”

That is Isaiah’s word fulfilled: “of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.” Daniel and his companions, of the king’s seed, were put under the master of the eunuchs and made eunuchs in that palace.

precepts.text: The word about sons made eunuchs in Babylon points forward to Daniel, a eunuch in the palace of the king of Babylon.
precepts.point: The prophecy adds that Hezekiah's own sons that issue from him would be taken and made eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon. Hezekiah called the word of the Lord good because there would be peace and truth in his days.

note.label: Isaiah 39: The Treasures Shown and Babylon Foretold

precepts.why:
Isaiah told Hezekiah, “of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.” Daniel shows it come to pass: “Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah”.

The word about sons made eunuchs in Babylon points forward to Daniel, of the children of Judah, a eunuch in the palace of the king of Babylon. Everything Hezekiah showed the men from Babylon, the silver, the gold, the spices, the ointment and all his armour, holding nothing back, was carried to Babylon with nothing left, and his sons went with it, just as Isaiah declared. Hezekiah called the word good because “there shall be peace and truth in my days”, but the days came.

precepts.text: The king commanded that certain children of Israel of the king's seed and princes, well favoured and skilful in wisdom, be taught the learning and tongue of the Chaldeans to stand in the king's palace.
precepts.point: When our people do well financially, get a good education, and buy into the pick-yourself-up-by-the-bootstraps idea that everyone has the same opportunity, the smart ones are removed from the ghetto so they will not be there to cause the uprising.

note.label: Ezekiel 17: The Riddle of the Two Eagles

precepts.why:
The king of Babylon “hath taken of the king’s seed” and “hath also taken the mighty of the land”. Daniel shows how it was done. The king told Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, to bring “certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes”: children “in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science”, such as had ability in them “to stand in the king’s palace”.

And what for? So that “they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.” The enemy takes the best and brightest and gives them the mind of the oppressor, so they are turned against their own people. That is how “the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up”.

It is the same today. When our people do well financially, get a good education and buy into the pick-yourself-up-by-the-bootstraps idea that everyone has the same opportunity, the smart ones are removed from the ghetto. They will not be there to cause the uprising.

precepts.text: Cyrus king of Persia brought forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer the vessels of the house of the Most High that Nebuchadnezzar had carried out of Jerusalem.
precepts.point: Nebuchadnezzar carried those vessels into the land of Shinar to the house of his god and put them in his treasure house. This came to pass exactly as the prophets had warned.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

precepts.why:
The vessels Nebuchadnezzar carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god did not stay there. “Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods; Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.”

Ezra confirms the same vessels, taken out of Jerusalem and put in the house of Nebuchadnezzar's gods, and shows Cyrus king of Persia bringing them forth again by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, numbered unto Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

precepts.text: Isaiah told Hezekiah that all that is in thine house shall be carried into Babylon, and thy sons shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
precepts.point: Nebuchadnezzar carried those vessels into the land of Shinar to the house of his god and put them in his treasure house. This came to pass exactly as the prophets had warned.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

precepts.why:
This came to pass exactly as the prophets had warned. When the men from Babylon had seen everything in Hezekiah's house, Isaiah told him, “Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord. And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”

Hezekiah had shown them all: “there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.” So when Nebuchadnezzar besieged Jerusalem, took Jehoiakim and carried part of the vessels of the house of God to the treasure house of his god, it was the word Isaiah spoke to Hezekiah being fulfilled, and the sons of Judah were to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
